text: A Hopf bifurcation, which gives birth to a limit cycle, occurs when:
choices: a single real eigenvalue passes through zero
a complex-conjugate pair of eigenvalues crosses the imaginary axis with nonzero speed
explanation: At a Hopf bifurcation a complex-conjugate eigenvalue pair crosses the imaginary axis (its real part changing sign), turning a stable focus unstable and spawning a small-amplitude limit cycle. A single real eigenvalue passing through zero instead produces saddle-node, transcritical, or pitchfork bifurcations.
